_comment: North American common names for GBIF taxa whose backbone vernacular is
global, British, or a lumped slash-form. GBIF gets the great majority of
US bird names right -- of 38 spot-checked common Massachusetts species,
only Circus cyaneus was wrong -- so this list stays small on purpose.
Slash-forms cannot be resolved automatically: 'Great Blue/Cocoi Heron'
needs the trailing noun ('Great Blue Heron') while 'Great Cormorant/
European Shag' must keep its own ('Great Cormorant'). Same shape, opposite
rule, so each is written out by hand.
Circus cyaneus: GBIF's backbone still lumps Northern Harrier (C. hudsonius)
into Eurasian Hen Harrier. Every Massachusetts record is a Northern Harrier,
so for a US regional dataset that is the correct label.
